rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition, explicit control reference, internal size factors, a minimal justified filter (>=10 in >=6), BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and an explicit refusal to deduplicate without UMIs all match the reference. QC includes blind VST PCA, sample distances, per-sample library size, duplication and rRNA/MT fractions, with a stated keep-by-default policy for sample_01; it loses a little for not stating the decision on whether to drop rRNA/mitochondrial genes from the matrix when their share is large and uneven, and for not addressing intronic share beyond noting it. Enrichment uses the full Wald-ranked list, Hallmark 2026.1, a 15-500 size window and the tested-gene universe, though Reactome is pinned only as 'current'. The report specification is complete with versions, counts, thresholds and design caveats.
